They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three…
The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them: for he who has mercy on them will lead…
The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads…
I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads…
Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.

parallels.note: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.
translations.bsb: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the Tent, the Israelites would set out, and wherever the cloud settled, there the Israelites would camp.
translations.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
translations.asv: And whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel encamped.
